parts.name: pig_tailed_macaque
sources: MakeHuman (CC0): the low-poly body male1591, the skeleton game_engine and its weights, and the low-poly eyes (https://github.com/makehumancommunity/mpfb2); the tail is of World. CC0 1.0 (public domain): https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

A northern pig-tailed macaque (khỉ đuôi lợn, Macaca leonina): a male about 55 cm long without the tail, a short thin tail of about 20 cm that curves up, a brown coat with a dark crown and a dark tail. It walks on four limbs.

Wikipedia, Northern pig-tailed macaque (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Northern_pig-tailed_macaque): its tails "are shorter and skinnier than southern pig-tailed macaques", with "a thin pelage in a dark blackish hue"; "A brown pelage patch is found on the centre of their crowns"; the range includes Vietnam.

Ecology Asia, Northern pig-tailed macaque (https://www.ecologyasia.com/verts/mammals/northern-pig-tailed-macaque.htm) and other sources: a male 50 to 59.5 cm long without the tail, a tail of 18 to 25 cm.
The numbers of the shape and the colors: from the long-tailed macaque, with a short tail that curves up; a guess from photos of iNaturalist.
The lengths of the fur (fur): a guess from photos of the animal, not a measurement.
